key_insight: Task-aware CT projection selection improves sparse-view hemodynamic prediction, but views optimized for this task can yield poor image reconstructions.
engineering_relevance: Acquisition tailored to downstream flow quantities could reduce CT measurement requirements without prioritizing anatomical reconstruction quality.
method: Generate synthetic fan-beam CTA projections from intracranial aneurysm CFD simulations.
Train a Fourier neural operator to predict spatial TAWSS fields and spatially averaged TAWSS.
Compare uniform and golden-angle sampling with Gumbel-Softmax, Soft top-K, and agentic AI selection.
evidence_signal: Across tested view budgets, agentic AI and Soft top-K achieved the lowest mean spatial-field errors, with agentic AI slightly better; optimized selection mattered most under extreme sparsity.
watch_item: Evaluation used synthetic CFD-derived projections; robustness to clinical CT noise and patient variability remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
